name: Elio Buzzers v4
description:
Project Elio Buzzers are designed for Bible Bowl and useful for trivia, game shows, and classrooms. Each unit features front and back RGB LEDs, a satisfying pushbutton, and connects to the rest of the system with CAT5E Ethernet cables. The buzzers are controlled by a central ESP32 hub and daisy chained together.

Includes eight buzzers (4 on each team), one remote clear button, and one main control box.
